# Frontend System Design Interview

> The client side of system design: rendering, state, caching, performance, and eight question walkthroughs. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Guide pages

- [The Frontend System Design Framework](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/framework.md): A frontend design answer has five steps: requirements, architecture, data model, interface, and optimizations.

## Cheat sheets

- [Common Mistakes in the Frontend System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Most weak answers in this round fail in the same few ways.
- [A Four-Week Plan for the Frontend System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/four-week-plan.md): This plan takes about six hours a week for four weeks, or 24 hours in total.
- [Frontend vs Backend System Design](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/frontend-vs-backend-system-design.md): Both rounds ask a candidate to design a system in about 45 minutes, and both reward clear requirements and named trade-offs.
- [Frontend System Design Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/question-bank.md): This page lists 40 questions in four groups.

## Concepts

- [Accessibility](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/accessibility.md): Accessibility means that people can use the page with a keyboard, a screen reader, voice control, or enlarged text.
- [Component API Design](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/component-api-design.md): A component API is the contract between a component and the code that uses it: its props, its events, and the parts it lets a consumer replace.
- [Data Fetching and Caching](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/data-fetching-and-caching.md): Data fetching covers how the client asks the server for data, how it pages through long lists, and how it avoids asking twice.
- [Micro-Frontends](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/micro-frontends.md): A micro-frontend architecture splits one web application into parts that separate teams build and deploy independently.
- [Offline and Storage](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/offline-and-storage.md): Browser storage keeps data on the user's device, and offline support lets a page work without a network connection.
- [Performance and Core Web Vitals](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/performance-and-core-web-vitals.md): Core Web Vitals are three metrics that Google defines to measure how a page feels to a user: loading, responsiveness, and visual stability.
- [Real-Time Updates](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/real-time-updates.md): A real-time feature shows new data without a page reload.
- [Rendering Strategies](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/rendering-strategies.md): A rendering strategy decides where and when the HTML of a page is produced.
- [Security](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/security.md): Frontend security in an interview centers on three topics: cross-site scripting, cross-site request forgery, and content security policy.
- [State Management](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/concepts/state-management.md): State is any data that can change while the page is open.

## Questions

- [Design a Chat App](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-chat-app.md): A chat frontend shows a list of conversations and the messages of the open one, and it sends and receives messages in real time.
- [Design a Collaborative Editor](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-collaborative-editor.md): A collaborative editor lets several people edit one document at the same time and see each other's changes within about a second.
- [Design a News Feed](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-news-feed.md): A news feed frontend shows an endless list of posts with text, images, and actions such as like and comment.
- [Design a Product Page](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-product-page.md): A product page shows one item of an online store: images, title, price, options such as size and color, stock, reviews, and an "add to cart" button.
- [Design a Real-Time Dashboard](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-real-time-dashboard.md): A real-time dashboard shows charts, counters, and tables that update while the user watches.
- [Design a Video Player](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-a-video-player.md): A video player loads a video, plays it without stalling on a changing network, and gives the user controls for play, seek, volume, captions, and quality.
- [Design an Image Gallery](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-an-image-gallery.md): An image gallery shows a grid of thumbnails and opens a larger view of one image at a time.
- [Design Autocomplete](https://github.com/design-gurus/frontend-system-design-interview/blob/main/questions/design-autocomplete.md): An autocomplete component shows suggestions while the user types in a search box.
